g.text: 4-2. The worker answers one chat job (text / image)
run() goes back to waiting - other sessions do not wait for this one
save images (only messages of type image in the buffer)
creates UPLOADS_DIR when it is not there
buffer has only text -> nothing is downloaded
role user - text: the text, image: the file path
to_openai per item - image: reads the file as base64
streamed call, joined into one answer + token counts
ai.chat raises (AI unreachable, error from the provider, ...)
nothing catches it: communicator.chat, run_chat and handle end with the error
no step below runs - no ai_calls row, no line.reply, messages stay pending
buffer stays, state stays PROCESSING . run() keeps looping for other jobs
later messages of this session: SET NX returns False -> no chat job (4-4)
sweeper: start_closing returns False -> the session is not closed (4-5)
request = the ContextMessage list (image = file path, not base64)
reply to the reporter, then close the round
reply token of the newest message in the buffer
INSERT messages, role assistant, status answered
mark_answered([message_id of every message in the buffer])
left in Redis for this session: history and last_message_at
they stay until the session is closed (4-5)
the next message starts again at 4-1
